No Bombs for Iran? #IranWar‌

Just over a week ago I noted a number of tankers from several bases across the US moving to Pease (KPSM) in what at the time I suspected might be preparation for a possible bomber mission to Iran. Tonight, several of those tankers are leaving the base and returning to their home sites, some on a Bomb Mission Code and others on other mission codes:

KC-46A "REACH227" 17-46036 #AE5E11
KC-46A "REACH679" 19-46063 #AE5FAA
KC-46A "SKATER77" 23-46120 #AF9E2A
KC-46A "SKATER78" 23-46117 #AFEAD2
KC-46A "SKATER79" 17-46032 #AE5E0D
KC-46A "SKATER80" 18-46039 #AE5F92

It's entirely possible these were not for Iran and were for the STRATCOM exercise that is ongoing, but they do not appear to have taken part in any case.
